browser.source: Parent-run isolated Chromium r3 using synthetic files

notRun.reason: PAGEHIDE-BACK verifies visible UI after an actual navigation. Navigation timing is recorded but does not prove persisted BFCache restoration or heap/Blob registry cleanup; no runtime listeners/hooks or CDP are injected.
Real cancellation/replacement is observed separately. An old completion delivered after termination cannot be forced without altering runtime/scheduling; no claim is made from a mock.

Root must supply and document genuine non-OS 200% text/page zoom, with before/after computed text metrics and the core workflow. No CSS injection, CDP call, transform or half-viewport substitute is used.
No fake-clock/runtime changes. M1 Node fake-clock evidence is not relabeled as a browser lifetime test.
Only synthetic setInputFiles and download.saveAs are allowed.
